title: 第一卷 第3章 枪法秘籍第一卷 第4章 第一次杀人
slug: 乱世加点从猎户到武圣只杀不赦
content_zh:
李毅无奈地叹了口气道：“哥，你这又何必呢？只要好好调养，总会好起来的。”
李二牛摇头道：“我自己的身子自己清楚，现在已经没法下地干活了，光靠小芳一个，这个家肯定支撑不下去，而且你也知道我的情况。
我还想请你给哥留个孩子，将来走了，也能有人惦记着，上个香什么的。
不然怕是要成为孤魂野鬼.
最重要的是，我不想被那帮人吃绝户！”
说到最后，李二牛眼中迸发出强烈的仇恨。
他被废的事，可不是意外那么简单。
李毅苦笑着说道：“不是我不想帮你，但我也有我的家要照顾，但二牛哥你放心，以后你要有需要我帮忙的，我绝不推辞。”
李二牛还是摇头，他要不是被逼到了绝境，也不会走这条路。
见李毅不答应，李二牛终究下定了决心。
他看向刘芳道：“你去把柜子里的那本旧书拿过来。”
刘芳立马跑去角落，一阵翻箱倒柜后，拿着一本残破的书籍走了回来。
李二牛郑重其事地接过后，小心翼翼地抚摸着封面，那模样像是在对待绝世奇珍。
“小毅，二伯应该教过你识字吧？”
李毅点了点头，在村里，他是为数不多识字的人。
李二牛将手中的旧书递到李毅面前，郑重其事地说道：“这门《裂风破阵枪》，是我大哥留下来的，最适合在战场上冲锋陷阵。
我天资不够，练了许久都没能练出门道。
或许你可以从中学到一些东西。”
李毅满脸诧异，武技这种东西，按理来说，根本不可能出现在农户之家。
一般都是在军中流传，又或者是拜入那些名门大派。

最重要的是，普通人家，也供养不起一个练武之人。
“二牛哥，这本秘籍太贵重了，我不能要！”
李二牛却坚决把秘籍塞到了李毅手中，道：“给你就收着，不然等哪天我走了，只会便宜那些畜生！”
说到这里，李二牛脸上闪过一丝内疚，道：“你跟我走得那么近，怕是早被他们盯上了，要不然那王大贵也不会逼你逼得那么紧。”
李毅顿时了然，他说怎么感觉王大贵怎么突然就盯上了他家。
合着是被李二牛牵连了。
但救命之恩摆在那，李毅也没法责怪李二牛。
至于李二牛跟他嘴里说的那些人之间的矛盾，李二牛并没有说的意思，李毅也不好追问。
想着自己要是去服役的话，确实需要一门适合用在战场上的武技，李毅便将其收了下来。
此外他也想了解一下这个世界的武技，跟他自身所学有什么不同。
但接下了秘籍，就等于接下了李二牛的因果。
李二牛知道让李毅帮他拉帮套，确实是强人所难，但他已经别无选择。
见李毅收下后，便转头对刘芳说道：“小芳，一会你就跟小毅回去，这两天先住他那吧。”
刘芳闻言一脸担忧地看着李二牛道：“可二牛哥你自己在家怎么办？”
李二牛哂笑道：“我又不是彻底瘫痪了，上厕所那些还是没问题的，这事是我们对不住小毅在先，没必要完全按那些规矩走，去吧！”
刘芳脸上闪过一丝苦涩，看了李毅一眼后，又低下了头。
李毅也有些尴尬，当着人家丈夫的面说这种事，他又不是变态的小日子，肯定会别扭。
李毅轻咳了一声后，站了起身，道：“二牛哥，要没什么事的话，我就先回去了，等回头空了再来看你。”
李二牛点了点头，脸上尽是欣慰。
content_en:
Li Yi sighed helplessly and said: "Brother, why are you doing this? As long as you take good care of yourself, you will get better."
Li Erniu shook his head and said: "I know my health well. Now I can no longer work in the fields. This family will definitely not be able to support Xiaofang alone, and you also know my situation.
I also want to ask you to leave a child for me. When you leave, there will be someone who will remember you and give you incense and so on.
Otherwise, I am afraid that I will become a lonely ghost.
The most important thing is, I don’t want to be eaten out by those people! "
At the end of the sentence, Li Erniu's eyes burst out with strong hatred.
The fact that he was deposed was not as simple as an accident.
Li Yi smiled bitterly and said: "It's not that I don't want to help you, but I also have my family to take care of. But brother Erniu, don't worry. If you need my help in the future, I will never refuse."
Li Erniu still shook his head. If he hadn't been forced into a desperate situation, he wouldn't have taken this path.
Seeing that Li Yi refused, Li Erniu finally made up his mind.
He looked at Liu Fang and said, "Go and get the old book from the cabinet."
Liu Fang immediately ran to the corner, rummaged through boxes and cabinets, and came back with a torn book.
After Li Erniu took it solemnly, he carefully touched the cover, as if he were treating a rare treasure.
"Xiao Yi, my second uncle should have taught you how to read, right?"
Li Yi nodded. He was one of the few literate people in the village.
Li Erniu handed the old book in his hand to Li Yi and said solemnly: "This "Splitting Wind Formation Gun" was left behind by my eldest brother and is most suitable for charging on the battlefield.
I'm not talented enough and I haven't been able to master the Taoist technique even after practicing for a long time.
Maybe you can learn something from it. "
Li Yi's face was full of surprise. Logically speaking, such things as martial arts were impossible to appear in farmers' homes.
Usually it is spread among the military, or people join those famous sects.
The most important thing is that ordinary people cannot afford to support a person who practices martial arts.
"Brother Erniu, this secret book is too valuable, I can't have it!"
But Li Erniu resolutely put the secret book into Li Yi's hand and said: "Just keep it, otherwise when I leave one day, I will only benefit those beasts!"
At this point, a trace of guilt flashed across Li Erniu's face, and he said: "You were so close to me, I'm afraid you've been targeted by them, otherwise Wang Dagui wouldn't have pressed you so hard."
Li Yi suddenly understood. He said why he felt that Wang Dagui suddenly targeted his family.
The co-author was implicated by Li Erniu.
But the life-saving grace was there, and Li Yi couldn't blame Li Erniu.
As for the conflicts between Li Erniu and the people he talked about, Li Erniu had no intention of talking about it, and it was not easy for Li Yi to pursue questions.
Thinking that if he went to serve, he would really need a martial arts suitable for use on the battlefield, so Li Yi accepted it.
In addition, he also wanted to understand the differences between the martial arts in this world and what he had learned himself.
But taking over the secret book is equivalent to taking over Li Erniu's cause and effect.
Li Erniu knew that asking Li Yi to help him was really difficult, but he had no choice.
After seeing Li Yi accept it, he turned to Liu Fang and said, "Xiao Fang, you will go back with Xiao Yi in a moment. Let's stay at his place for the next two days."
Hearing this, Liu Fang looked at Li Erniu with a worried look and said, "But brother Erniu, what will you do at home?"
Li Erniu laughed and said: "I'm not completely paralyzed. Going to the toilet is still no problem. We can't help Xiaoyi first. There's no need to follow those rules exactly. Go ahead!"
A trace of bitterness flashed across Liu Fang's face. After taking a look at Li Yi, she lowered her head.
Li Yi was also a little embarrassed. He would definitely feel awkward saying this in front of his husband. He was not a perverted little boy.
After Li Yi coughed lightly, he stood up and said, "Brother Erniu, if nothing happens, I will go back first and wait until I have time to go back."Come to see you. "
Li Erniu nodded, his face full of relief.
